cards.content: **Floor breakers are status only.** They feed the router, Wi-Fi and this server; switching one off from here could take the network down with no remote way back.

Automations close the grid fallback at **30%** battery or when the house draws more than **5.5 kW**, and open it again at **40%** once the load is under **4 kW**. Inverter settings are on the **Solar Inverter Settings** page in the sidebar.
